quest.title: Dream of Wind and Flowers
quest.description: On account of your contributions to Mondstadt, you have been chosen as this year's Windblume Star. As such, you will be making a Windblume offering to the Anemo Archon, Barbatos, on behalf of the whole of Mondstadt. That said, what on earth is a Windblume?
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x60, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000

talks.objective: Wait for the appointed time and go to the Mondstadt plaza

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Jean!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Traveler! Ah — excuse me. I should address you as Honorary Knight under the circumstances.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I suppose you heard? You're this year's Windblume Star. You will be making an offering of Windblumes to the Anemo Archon, Barbatos, on behalf of the whole of Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: ...Although... things will be a little different this time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sigh* ...Yeah... But with us and the Tone-Deaf Bard here, this year's Windblume Festival is sure to be bigger than ever!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: That is true... Thank you for taking up residence in Mondstadt, and I hope you continue to enjoy Mondstadt life.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Oh! The Windblume Ceremony is about to begin. Windblume Star, have you chosen your Windblume?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So we choose one type of flower, then offer it to the Anemo Archon, right?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Exactly right. Please consider your choice carefully. Remember, you are representing the whole of Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Venti, what kind of flower do you like?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Eh? ...Very cunning, trying to cheat, are we?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Ahem...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Don't you two go spilling secrets during an occasion like this!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Haha, they told us!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Don't worry about me, choose something you like! I trust your tastes.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: So, Honorary Knight, what is your choice?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahhhh... throwing your weight behind one of the people's favorites! Windblumes must be dandelions after all!

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: On behalf of the people of Mondstadt, please offer your Windblume to the statue.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahhhh... Throwing your weight behind one of the people's favorites! Windblumes must be Windwheel Asters after all!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! Same idea as Beatrice, Cecilias for Windblumes. Pretty niche, but not without advocates!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! Same idea as Nimrod, Small Lamp Grass for Windblumes... A flower to light up the dark!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! Same idea as Sucrose, Sweet Flowers for Windblumes. A flower that has lasted through the ages!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! Same idea as Razor, Wolfhooks for Windblumes. Spiky and tingly!

talks.objective: Make a Windblume offering to the Anemo Archon

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Thank you, Windblume Star, for your sincere Windblume offering to the Anemo Archon, Barbatos. May the wind protect Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Huh, interesting choice.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You like it?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hehe, take a guess...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Typical Tone-Deaf Bard, stop making people guess all the time!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Ahahahaha! Okay, okay, I'll tell you. But not here though.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Not a good idea with so many people in the plaza... Change of surroundings needed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Where should we go?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I want you to come with me to Stormterror's Lair.

talks.objective: Solve the issue of the disorderly wind currents in the ruins

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Ah... now this is a view.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Isn't it? I am fond of this place. Sometimes, when I've got nothing else to do, I come here just to sit and gaze awhile.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You mean sit and laze around?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Hahaha, guilty as charged!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: ...It's so beautiful... if only we had some cider in hand.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: So, Traveler. The Mondstadt Windblume Festival. Do you like it?

choices.text: It's full of love and cheer.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: And yet, you still have something you wish to ask, do you not?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: I know your question. What are Windblumes, exactly? And what do Windblumes and the Windblume Festival mean to Barbatos, the Anemo Archon?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: As you've seen, the people of Mondstadt each make their own choice. Out of the millions of flowers there are, some choose the dandelion, others choose the Windwheel Aster.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh... it does seem like "Windblume" means something unique to each person.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Correct, and long may that be the case. There is no single answer and no true Windblumes in existence.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So Windblumes... don't really exist?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: The word "Windblume" dates from the age of Old Mondstadt. It was a code word that the people used to stay in contact and mount resistance in secret.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: At that time, the people often said that the stronger the wind blows, the firmer the roots of the Windblume grow, and the brighter the flowers that burst into bloom.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: If you want my perspective, Windblumes don't exist. Yet they are all around us nonetheless.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: They are the spirit of yearning for freedom, the courage to follow the wind wherever it may lead... All objects that are beautiful and worthy of blessing... All can be Windblumes.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You can't see them, but you can feel their presence everywhere... just like the wind!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Haha, well said.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: So what are Windblumes? Something that the Anemo Archon Barbatos will not define.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Flowers of blessings, flowers of respect, flowers of love. Every individual has their own Windblumes, and every individual has the right to define them.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Guess it's no surprise that the type of flower given by the City of Freedom to its deity is in itself an expression of freedom.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I enjoy the feeling of freedom, too.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: I know.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: It is people's shared will that brings them onto the same page. And surely, it is the wind of freedom that brought us together.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: It comes from the end of the journey, the edge of the world, the depths of our hearts. It is ceaseless.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: "Who was it that stroked your bloodied, determined visage\nBy stream flowing small\nBy boulder standing large"

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: "Who was it that embraced your weary yet noble soul\nIn dreams deep\nIn skies soaring"

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: "Dear friend\nI am leading you by the hand\nInto the night where lanterns shine bright"

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: "To tell you a tale of freedom and dreams\nThe tale of where this festival begins"

choices.text: It's great to be with everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: May the wind carry our blessings and praise.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: What will the Windblume be this year? I can't wait to find out!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Follow your instinct. Choose whichever Windblume you see fit.
